Cobalt's net balance is 41045, which matches my check: orders 31414 + 14972 = 46386, minus refund 5341. All three balances agree with the orders and refunds, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme.

Birch's payout is recorded. Cobalt's balance of 41045 matches the orders (31414 + 14972 = 46386) minus refund 285 (5341), so I'll record cobalt's payout to finish the batch.
